info.name: AppointmentHub - REST API tests
info.description:
# AppointmentHub - REST API test collection

Implements the API test strategy of the PDR (sections 10, 14 and 17) for the
endpoints `GET /api/services`, `GET /api/availability`, `POST /api/appointments`,
`GET /api/appointments`, `GET /api/appointments/{id}` and
`DELETE /api/appointments/{id}`.

## How to run

1. Start the application: `java -jar target/appointmenthub.jar --store=memory`
   (or `./mvnw exec:java`).
2. Import `AppointmentHub.postman_collection.json` and
   `AppointmentHub.postman_environment.json`, then select the environment.
3. Run the collection, or use Newman:

   `newman run postman/AppointmentHub.postman_collection.json -e postman/AppointmentHub.postman_environment.json`

## What is verified

* HTTP status code, response structure, data types and expected values.
* Business rules: required fields, email format, past dates, business hours,
  service duration, slot alignment, duplicate prevention and cancellation rules.
* Error contract: consistent `errorCode`, `message` and `status` fields.
* Response time against the 2 second acceptance target (NFR-02).
* Persistence of every change through a follow-up request.

## Test data

Every request that needs a free slot computes its own far future date, so the
collection can be run repeatedly against the same instance without cleaning data
and without depending on the order of the folders (PDR 14.5). Folders 02 to 04
and 07 form a documented chain: they reuse the appointment created earlier in the
run.
